items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: I worked there six months with them. Bill and D.D. and Alba Jow.

ctx.x: Arlington. Right where, uh, Woolworth's now on Ramp on Canal. Uh-huh. Right in the middle of the block they had a club they called, uh, Club Arlington. And I worked there. Oh, Arlington. Arlington. I worked there six months with them. Bill and D.D. and Alba Jow.
Do you know who Arlington was? Did you meet anyone named Arlington?
